title: elatostema monandrum var. pinnatifidum
intro: Elatostema monandrum var. pinnatifidum, commonly known as Pinnatifid Elatostema, is a species of flowering plant in the nettle family Urticaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, digestive issues, and skin problems. The plant is reported to exhibit anti-inflammatory and analgesic therapeutic actions, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and phenolic acids. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy of these constituents in providing the reported health benefits.
